findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Monoid.lean:968 `theorem continuous_finsetProd`, :972 `@[deprecated (since := "2026-04-08")] alias continuous_finset_sum := continuous_finsetSum`. The repo already uses the new form: Identifiability.lean:342 `continuous_finsetSum`, Mellin.lean:136 `mellinDis_finsetSum`; code/skipped_patches.txt:45 names the rename patch.
findings.issue: `isIRCSafe_finset_sum` (and `isIRCSafe_finset_prod`, line 263) use the `finset_sum`/`finset_prod` spelling that the pinned Mathlib deprecated in favour of `finsetSum`/`finsetProd`.

findings.fix: Rename to `IsCollinearSafe.apply_zero_cons`, matching the infix reading of `0 ::ₘ s`.
findings.issue: `IsCollinearSafe.apply_cons_zero : O (0 ::ₘ s) = O s` — upstream `cons_zero` means consing onto the zero *multiset*, not consing the zero *element*. The PR itself uses the upstream sense at Counterexamples.lean:80 and :114 (`rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, …]`), so the same token carries two meanings in one package.

findings.evidence: `HasSum.map` is the same shape (receiver is the inner object, post-composed with a continuous map); used as `HasSum.map (v.m_iUnion hg₁ hg₂) f hf` at mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/VectorMeasure/Operations.lean:228.
findings.issue: `IsCollinearSafe.comp` (also `IsInfraredSafe.comp` line 195, `IsIRCSafe.comp` line 222, `IsIRCSafe.comp₂` line 231) take the receiver as the inner function and conclude about `f ∘ O`. In Mathlib `.comp` always has the outer function as receiver (`Continuous.comp`, `Tendsto.comp`, `Measurable.comp`), so `hO.comp f` reads backwards.

findings.evidence: grep `invariantMass` in code/ matches only Basic.lean:42 (docstring) and Basic.lean:295 (this theorem); roadmap JetsAndEventShapes/README.md:281-283 asks for `totalMomentum` and the invariant mass squared as definitions.
findings.fix: Name it after the conclusion, e.g. `isIRCSafe_bilinForm_sum_sum`, and keep `invariantMassSq` for the definition when it is introduced.
findings.issue: `isIRCSafe_invariantMassSq` names a definition that does not exist anywhere in the repo; the statement is `IsIRCSafe (fun s => g s.sum s.sum)` for an arbitrary `LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V`. This also pre-empts the name for the `invariantMassSq` definition roadmap §0.1 asks for.

summary: Four naming issues: two lemmas use the Mathlib-deprecated `finset_sum`/`finset_prod` spelling, `apply_cons_zero` reuses `cons_zero` with the opposite meaning, the `.comp` family inverts Mathlib's receiver direction, and `isIRCSafe_invariantMassSq` names a nonexistent declaration.
